steps.task: Fill the result list using this topic's rule.
hints: readings lists matrix sizes. A matrix is a table of numbers with rows and columns. Matrix 0 has readings[0] rows and readings[1] columns. Matrix 1 has readings[1] rows and readings[2] columns, and so on. Multiplying an a-by-b matrix by a b-by-c matrix costs a * b * c number multiplications. You may group the matrices with brackets, but must keep their order. Different groups can have different costs. For the first matrix alone, record 0. Then record the least total cost for the first two matrices, the first three, and so on. Fewer than two size numbers means there are no matrices, so the result list is empty.
Revisit the example and copy one instruction at a time, checking what it does.
